text:
incident-bot: PAGER | service=runtime severity=page -> Detected crashlooping containers on gpu-pool-7 (node gpu-worker-7). SIGSEGV in /opt/runtime/lib/tensorrt_fused_kernel.so across 3 pods. Paging @alice. Created incident channel.

alice: Oncall here, jumping in. Pulling logs and pod status.

alice: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:45:12Z] runtime[pid=2345] ERROR: segfault at 0x0 in tensorrt_fused_kernel.so+0x1a3f
#0  0x7f8c2a1a3f in tensorrt_fused_kernel::execute(...)
#1  0x7f8c2b2b10 in runtime::invoke_kernel(...)
```

bob: Confirming API error spike: 503s up ~11% for hosted inference in last 3m, some dedicated customers on same pool affected. Customer impact: timeouts + retries.

carol: Preliminary ask: cordon gpu-worker-7 and drain pods, check nvidia-smi for ECC/driver errors. Could be bad kernel compile or new fused kernel release.

alice: Can we fallback traffic to cpu variant or older runtime build? We have fallback model variant and CPU runtime for critical routes.

deploy-bot: Rollout action queued: canary switch to runtime-service:variant=fallback-cpu at 10% -> triggered by @alice. Status: started.

dave: Applying emergency env toggle to disable fused kernels on prod deployment. Command:
```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/runtime-service RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 && kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-service -n prod
```

dave: Patch applied, pods restarting now. Watching pod states.

alice: Observability update: crashloops reduced. gpu-worker-7 pods went from CrashLoopBackOff x3 -> restarting normally. Error rate falling toward baseline.

bob: Customer telemetry: request success rate climbing, no new 5xx after the patch for the affected routes. Will keep monitoring 15m window.

eve: Support update: opening CS tickets for top impacted customers, sending interim notice explaining mitigation and ETA for full fix.

carol: Capture core dumps and stacktraces for offline analysis. Please upload to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/5123456789 and tag with node/pod info. Also grab `nvidia-smi -q` output and driver versions.

alice: Saved artifacts: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/5123456789/core.gpu-worker-7.1.dmp, runtime-logs/gpu-worker-7-2345.log, nvidia-smi/gpu-worker-7.txt

alice: Handoff summary -> frank: segfault in tensorrt_fused_kernel caused container crashloops on gpu-worker-7; mitigation: set RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 and restart pods, canary fallback to cpu variant at 10%, cordoned node for deeper forensics. Impact: ~11% 5xx spike for hosted API; no data loss; support tickets opened. Next actions: reproduce with same kernel/build, add guards in fused-kernel code to avoid null deref, plan rollback or safe rebuild.

frank: Taking over monitoring and postmortem lead. I'll keep the channel live, coordinate with research/infra to repro and patch. Add any traces or notes here.

incident-bot: Incident status -> STABILIZED. Pager cleared. Please create postmortem ticket INC-5123456789 and assign to @frank.
